compiled_state.title: Add query-stats.sh subcommand dispatcher (roundtrip/counts/recent/missing/sizes) with RED bash tests
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: roundtrip emits test event + verifies S3 landing; exit 0 on success
- dd-2: counts/recent/missing/sizes produce non-error output with date-range partitioning (--days=N glob; NOT full-bucket scan)
- dd-3: unknown subcommand → exit 1 + usage listing 5 valid subcommands

## Implementation Notes
Create plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh (mirror aws-status.sh + aws-teardown.sh pattern). 5 subcommands:
1. roundtrip: emit test event (client_id=dso-roundtrip-test) + poll S3 for landing within timeout
2. counts: DuckDB query grouping by client_id over --days=N date-glob partition
3. recent: most recent N events across date-glob
4. missing: date-partition gaps in --days=N window
5. sizes: per-day object/byte counts

Unknown subcommand → exit 1 + usage listing all 5.

DSO_AWS_CMD + DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD + DSO_DUCKDB_CMD env overrides for test stubbing.
DuckDB v1.5.3; httpfs extension.
ShellCheck-clean; set -euo pipefail.

Tests: tests/scripts/test-query-stats.sh
- Stub DSO_AWS_CMD/DSO_DUCKDB_CMD/DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD
- Assert each subcommand's DuckDB query string contains date-glob fragment (NO full-bucket scan)
- Unknown subcommand exits 1 + lists all 5 names

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Script exists, executable, set -euo pipefail
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh && grep -q '^set -euo pipefail' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] ShellCheck passes
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] Test file exists, executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-query-stats.sh
- [ ] Bash test suite passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-query-stats.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] Unknown subcommand exits 1
  Verify: { plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh bogus 2>/dev/null; test $? -eq 1; }
- [ ] Unknown-subcommand output lists all 5 valid subcommands
  Verify: out=$(plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh bogus 2>&1 || true); for s in roundtrip counts recent missing sizes; do echo "$out" | grep -q "$s" || exit 1; done
- [ ] DSO_AWS_CMD/DSO_DUCKDB_CMD/DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD overrides honored
  Verify: grep -qE 'DSO_AWS_CMD|DSO_DUCKDB_CMD|DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] roundtrip uses client_id=dso-roundtrip-test
  Verify: grep -q 'dso-roundtrip-test' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body:
AMENDMENT (gap analysis): Add these ACs to address dd-1 verify + dd-2 date-glob + env-override conjunction.

- [ ] DSO_AWS_CMD override referenced in script
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_AWS_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD override referenced in script
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] DSO_DUCKDB_CMD override referenced in script
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_DUCKDB_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] Test asserts each query subcommand's DuckDB invocation contains a date-glob path fragment (NOT full-bucket scan)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-query-stats.sh 2>&1 | grep -qE '(date.?glob|YYYY-MM-DD|--days)'
- [ ] Roundtrip polls S3 for landing — emits AND verifies (dd-1 second half)
  Verify: grep -qE '(while|for|sleep|poll|retry)' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh && grep -qE '(roundtrip|client_id)' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh
- [ ] DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD invoked by script (not just mentioned in comment)
  Verify: grep -qE '\$DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD|\$\{DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/query-stats.sh

Supersedes the single disjunction-style env-override AC. Sentinel client_id=dso-roundtrip-test remains as a strengthened payload-capture assertion enforced by the bash test.
